description: This file contains implementation of arithmetic computation routines used in FreeType, including fixed-point math functions, matrix operations, vector transformations, and geometric calculations, with support for 64-bit emulation.

classes.name: FT_Int64
classes.description: Emulation of 64-bit integer type with low and high 32-bit parts.

methods.name: FT_RoundFix
methods.description: Rounds a fixed-point value to the nearest integer.

methods.name: FT_MulDiv
methods.description: Performs 64-bit multiplication and division with sign handling.

methods.name: FT_MulFix
methods.description: Multiplies two fixed-point values with scaling.

methods.name: FT_DivFix
methods.description: Divides two fixed-point values with sign handling.

methods.name: FT_Vector_Transform_Scaled
methods.description: Transforms a vector by a scaled matrix.

methods.name: FT_Vector_NormLen
methods.description: Calculates the normalized length of a vector.

methods.name: ft_corner_orientation
methods.description: Determines the orientation of a corner formed by two vectors.

methods.name: ft_corner_is_flat
methods.description: Checks if a corner formed by two vectors is flat.
